lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the primary high-luminance blobs, creating visible anchor nodes in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal aspect and shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Notable transition in pattern density from large, sparse blobs on the lateral flank to a high-density cluster of significantly smaller, low-intensity spots on the cranial region.
